description: Queue one manual run using the tracker’s saved tool inputs. A repeated requestToken returns the same logical run. Managing trackers and reading reports is free; each run bills one call per prompt at the per-surface rates.

requestToken.description: Stable caller-generated token used to deduplicate a retried manual run.

trackerId.description: Cite42 tracker ID returned by a tracker management or report tool.
